changes.title: Ordinary floor equipment
changes.text: Ordinary floor loot and hidden-book loot follow Equipment Availability while scheduled progression items remain unchanged.

changes.title: Hermit crab equipment
changes.text: Hermit crab's generated armor follows Equipment Availability.

changes.title: Mimic bonus equipment
changes.text: Newly generated mimic bonus equipment follows Equipment Availability; carried prizes and stolen items are not filtered again.

changes.title: Monster equipment drops
changes.text: Generated monster equipment, wealth bonuses and lucky drops follow Equipment Availability; existing item instances remain intact.

changes.title: Armored statue loot
changes.text: Armored statue armor drops follow Equipment Availability without changing the armor used in combat.

changes.title: Statue loot
changes.text: Statue weapon drops follow Equipment Availability without changing the weapon used in combat.

changes.title: Grave equipment
changes.text: Random equipment in grassy graves follows Equipment Availability.

changes.title: Blacksmith room loot
changes.text: Incidental floor equipment in the blacksmith room follows Equipment Availability; quest reward selection is unchanged.

changes.title: Mass-grave equipment
changes.text: Incidental mass-grave equipment follows Equipment Availability while corpse dust and quest progression remain unchanged.

changes.title: Maze equipment
changes.text: Secret-maze equipment follows Equipment Availability.

changes.title: Summoning-room equipment
changes.text: Random equipment in secret summoning rooms follows Equipment Availability.

changes.title: Artillery equipment
changes.text: Secret-artillery missile equipment follows Equipment Availability; bombs are unchanged.

changes.title: Chasm chest equipment
changes.text: Random equipment in chasm chests follows Equipment Availability; key placement remains intact.

changes.title: Pit equipment
changes.text: Pit-room equipment follows Equipment Availability while haunted remains and keys keep their existing behavior.

changes.title: Trap-room equipment
changes.text: Trap-room equipment follows Equipment Availability without changing traps.

changes.title: Pool equipment
changes.text: Pool-room equipment follows Equipment Availability.

changes.title: Shop equipment
changes.text: Shop equipment stock follows Equipment Availability while consumables, bags and other progression stock remain unchanged.

changes.title: Sentry-room equipment
changes.text: Sentry-room equipment follows Equipment Availability; sentry timing is unchanged.

changes.title: Armory equipment
changes.text: Armory equipment follows Equipment Availability while bombs and the catalyst retain their original behavior.

changes.title: Optional chest equipment
changes.text: Optional crystal-choice chest equipment follows Equipment Availability while its exploration treatment and keys remain intact.

changes.title: Crypt equipment
changes.text: Crypt armor follows Equipment Availability while tomb behavior remains intact.

changes.title: Crystal-vault equipment
changes.text: Crystal-vault equipment follows Equipment Availability, including newly generated crystal-mimic prizes.

changes.title: Equipment Availability
changes.text: Enabled Equipment Availability at ordinary generation boundaries; fresh extra items are generated without filtering player inventory or general item drops.

changes.title: Chest batch placement
changes.text: Generated batches are added before sealing their chest, preventing extra items from searching forever for an adjacent placement cell.

changes.title: Equipment boundaries
changes.text: Added checks for all eight percentages, neutral RNG, distinct extra items and protected progression items.

changes.title: Generated equipment regressions
changes.text: Added real floor and shop checks for all classes, neutral source snapshots and isolated crystal-chest batch placement.

changes.title: Monster and stolen-item checks
changes.text: Added actual monster-drop checks proving fresh equipment expands while existing loot and stolen player items remain intact.

changes.title: Equipment control on Android
changes.text: Added an Android touch-and-save check for Equipment Availability that preserves active-run rules and earned scores.

changes.title: Verification records
changes.text: Recorded verified TEST121 checks, equipment implementation and remaining alpha limitations.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I added equipment availability across ordinary loot sources and caught a chest-placement hang before release. Offensive damage attribution and permanent custom-rules statistics integration still need work; this is not the completed early alpha.
